plan.required: Each scene mean PSNR delta >= 0.2 dB and mean SSIM delta >= 0; every pair PSNR >= -0.2 and SSIM >= -0.005. Screening only, not a statistical guarantee or default adoption.
plan.hypothesis: Removing all points with duplicate image IDs in their tracks improves seed reliability without pose or image changes.
plan.cache: Frozen SfM, fresh Brush processes, Metal/system caches not flushed; serial GPU, no browser rendering.
